question: Suppose that \(AB\) is an arc of a circle with a given radius and centre subtending an angle \(\theta\) (\(0<\theta<\pi\) is fixed) at the centre. Consider an arbitrary point \(P\) on this arc and the product \(l(AP)\cdot l(PB)\), where \(l(AP)\) and \(l(PB)\) denote the lengths of the straight lines \(AP\) and \(PB\), respectively. Determine possible location(s) of \(P\) for which this product will be maximized. Justify your answer.
